labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Asks how to get orange text; Rich already supports orange1 and hex colours.

body:
Rich already supports orange text. Use a named colour in a style, for example `console.print("Hello", style="orange1")`, or a hex colour such as `style="#ff8700"`. The full list of named colours is in the [appendix](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/appendix/colors.rst), and the style syntax is described in [style.rst](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/style.rst).

For questions about how to use Rich, [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) is the best place to ask.
